Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: It fixed the calculation on unverified prices—using a third-party “as low as” daily ticket price ($39.22 from FunEx) and an assumed season pass price ($89) without confirming they applied to California’s Great America for the specific 2024 summer dates or included taxes/fees. Relying on a discounted minimum and an unverified pass tier led to an inaccurate savings figure.
